boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified, under-21-safe Erie outings with no admission or required purchase, including Gannon benefits, public learning spaces, and Presque Isle recreation.

cards.title: Browse the Erie Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Free museum admission with a current Gannon ID
cards.notes: Bring your Gannon ID, enter from East Fifth Street, and compare a few works together without buying a ticket.
cards.short_summary: Turn a downtown walk into a free student art outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that Gannon University students, faculty, and staff receive free admission when they present university ID.
cards.source_title: Museum Hours & Directions — Erie Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Present a current Gannon student ID for free admission; visit only during the museum's posted public hours.

cards.entity_name: Center for Lake Erie Education and Research
cards.title: Explore CLEER’s Lake Erie Exhibits
cards.subtitle: A free Gannon learning space inside Blasco Library
cards.notes: Meet inside Blasco Library and work through the hands-on displays while comparing what each reveals about Lake Erie.
cards.short_summary: Explore Great Lakes science through public, hands-on exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon states that CLEER is open to the public during regular Blasco Library hours and that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Center for Lake Erie Education and Research opens at Blasco Library
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during regular Blasco Library hours; Gannon explicitly states that admission is free.

cards.title: Tour TREC’s Exhibits and Tower
cards.subtitle: Free environmental exhibits and a 75-foot observation tower
cards.notes: Start with the orientation displays, then climb the enclosed tower for a group view toward Presque Isle and Lake Erie.
cards.short_summary: Pair environmental exhibits with an elevated lake view.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR states that admission to TREC's interactive exhibits and 75-foot observation tower is free.
cards.access_notes: The exhibits, enclosed tower, and orientation movie have free admission; check the official page for seasonal operating days.

cards.entity_name: Erie Metropolitan Transit Authority e Bus
cards.title: Take a Fare-Free City Ride
cards.subtitle: Gannon ID unlocks the fixed-route bus network
cards.notes: Add the current e sticker to your Gannon ID, meet at West Seventh and Peach, and choose a fixed-route destination together.
cards.short_summary: Use the student transit benefit for a no-fare Erie outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon states that students, faculty, and staff can ride any EMTA e fixed-route bus free with a Gannon ID bearing the current e sticker.
cards.source_title: Bus Service and University Loop | Gannon University
cards.access_notes: Gannon students ride fixed-route e buses free with a Gannon ID and current e sticker; route schedules vary.

cards.title: Plan a Group Workout at the RWC
cards.subtitle: Free facility membership for enrolled Gannon students
cards.notes: Bring your Gannon ID and choose a shared workout that fits everyone’s ability; confirm facility availability before meeting.
cards.short_summary: Make a social workout from an included student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon states that all enrolled students have access to a free Recreation and Wellness Center membership and may enter with Gannon ID.
cards.access_notes: Free membership is limited to enrolled Gannon students and other eligible university groups; Gannon ID is required.

cards.title: Make Something in the Idea Lab
cards.subtitle: Free equipment access and classes for adults
cards.notes: Check equipment status, reserve a station if required, and pick a project that uses only the Lab’s no-fee supplies or tools.
cards.short_summary: Share a maker session without paying for access or instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Erie County Public Library describes the Idea Lab as an adult maker space offering free access to equipment and classes.
cards.source_title: Idea Lab | Erie County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Access and classes are free, but some materials can carry fees; choose a project requiring no paid materials and complete any required certification.

cards.title: Walk the Graveyard Pond Trail
cards.subtitle: A 0.75-mile lagoon-side outing at Presque Isle
cards.notes: Meet at the trailhead, follow the out-and-back route, and pause at the boat landings for lagoon views before returning.
cards.short_summary: Take an easy waterside walk with two scenic stopping points.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR identifies Graveyard Pond Trail as an easy 0.75-mile hiking route with lagoon views; state parks have no entrance or day-use fees.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Presque Isle State Park
cards.access_notes: No park entrance or day-use fee applies. Stay on the official trail and check current park conditions before departing.

cards.title: Walk Out to North Pier Light
cards.subtitle: A free harbor-channel sightseeing walk
cards.notes: Follow the public route toward the light, watch boats move through the harbor channel, and turn back if waves reach the walkway.
cards.short_summary: Watch Erie’s working harbor from a historic pier light.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR states that visitors can walk to North Pier Light and watch harbor-channel boat traffic; state parks charge no entrance fee.
cards.source_title: History of Presque Isle State Park
cards.access_notes: Presque Isle has no entrance or day-use fee. Use the public walkway only and avoid the pier during rough water or hazardous weather.

cards.title: Swim at Kohler Beach
cards.subtitle: A guarded-season beach hang at Presque Isle
cards.notes: Check the guarded-zone status, meet near the beach house, and keep the group inside the marked swimming area while lifeguards are present.
cards.short_summary: Cool off together at a sheltered Lake Erie beach.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR identifies Beach 11 as a sheltered designated beach and permits swimming only in open guarded zones; state parks have no day-use fee.
cards.source_title: Swimming at Presque Isle State Park
cards.access_notes: No entrance or day-use fee applies. Swim only when the beach is open, lifeguards are present, and the guarded zone is designated.

cards.title: Take a Gull Point Nature Walk
cards.subtitle: A 1.5-mile route through a protected natural area
cards.notes: Check trail conditions at TREC, pack water, and remain on the marked surface to protect nesting birds and wet habitats.
cards.short_summary: See shifting dunes and habitat succession on a careful group hike.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR documents Gull Point Trail as a 1.5-mile hiking route through the natural area; Pennsylvania state parks have no entrance fee.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Presque Isle State Park
cards.access_notes: No park entrance or day-use fee applies. From April 1 through October 31, remain on the trail surface because of nesting birds.
